disclaimer: Demand tags and salary figures are indicative estimates based on Indian job boards and industry reports, not guaranteed facts. Compensation varies significantly by city, college tier, and company type.

fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: service firms typically ₹3.5-5.5 LPA; product startups and GCCs in Bengaluru/Hyderabad/NCR ₹7.0-12.0+ LPA.

saturated_skills: HTML/CSS-only static portfolios
Basic React + JavaScript TODO CRUD apps
Unauthenticated MERN clones without tests
jQuery & legacy Bootstrap templates
market_demand.entry_level_reality: High volume of entry-level applicants with identical MERN clones on Naukri and LinkedIn India (0-2 yrs). Startups on Wellfound and Instahyre filter heavily for TypeScript, Next.js, database modeling, testing, and deployed production apps.
market_demand.source: Naukri JobSpeak Index, LinkedIn Jobs India (0-2 yrs), Wellfound, Instahyre & AmbitionBox

fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: entry-level ML/GenAI roles pay higher at GCCs and AI startups in Bengaluru/Hyderabad, while notebook-only resumes struggle to clear technical screens.

saturated_skills: Kaggle Titanic / Iris copy-paste notebooks
Prompt-only ChatGPT wrapper demos
Unexplained pre-trained API calls without evaluation
market_demand.entry_level_reality: NASSCOM and LinkedIn India show rising demand for applied AI engineers who can ship, evaluate, and monitor models in production. Pure research roles remain scarce for B.Tech freshers without strong math, software engineering, and deployed projects.
market_demand.source: NASSCOM AI Reports, LinkedIn Jobs India (0-2 yrs), Stack Overflow Survey & Levels.fyi

fresher_salary_range_inr.display: ₹4.0 – ₹14.0 LPA (Data Analyst to Junior Data Engineer)
fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: pure dashboard-only analyst roles are competitive, whereas SQL + Python + PySpark/dbt data engineering roles command stronger offers across GCCs and fintech.

hot_skills: Window Functions & Query Tuning in SQL
saturated_skills: Basic Excel VLOOKUP-only reporting
Static PowerBI/Tableau dashboards with zero SQL modeling
Unsupervised CSV cleanup scripts without schema design
market_demand.entry_level_reality: Indian GCCs, banks, and SaaS companies consistently hire 0-2 year candidates who combine strong SQL and data modeling with Python ETL pipelines. Pure BI drag-and-drop skills without SQL depth face high applicant competition.
market_demand.source: Naukri JobSpeak Index, TeamLease Digital, LinkedIn Jobs India & AmbitionBox

fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: entry-level openings strongly favor hands-on Linux, Docker, CI/CD, and Terraform labs over theory-only cloud certificates.

saturated_skills: Unpracticed Cloud Practitioner badge without labs
Manual EC2 click-ops setups
Shared-hosting cPanel administration
market_demand.entry_level_reality: While senior DevOps is massive on Naukri, entry-level roles (0-2 yrs) require proving real Linux, networking, containerization, and automation projects rather than memorizing cloud service names.
market_demand.source: LinkedIn Jobs India (0-2 yrs), Naukri.com, Stack Overflow Developer Survey & AmbitionBox

fresher_salary_range_inr.display: ₹4.0 – ₹13.0 LPA (SOC Tier-1 to AppSec / Cloud Sec)
fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: fintech, SaaS, and Big-4/MSSP practices in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, and NCR actively recruit SOC and AppSec graduates with lab portfolios.

saturated_skills: Automated Kali Linux tool-running without understanding protocols
Generic phishing-awareness slide decks
Unverified Nmap scan screenshots
market_demand.entry_level_reality: India's DPDP Act compliance and enterprise cloud adoption are driving steady AppSec and SOC hiring. Freshers break in fastest via TryHackMe/Hack The Box writeups, networking mastery, and understanding how to fix vulnerable code.
market_demand.source: NASSCOM Cybersecurity Reports, LinkedIn Jobs India (0-2 yrs) & AmbitionBox

fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: consumer startups and fintechs in Bengaluru/NCR pay well for Kotlin/Compose, React Native, or Flutter engineers who ship polished apps.

hot_skills: Secure Auth, Deep Linking & Payments Integration
saturated_skills: Java XML legacy Android starter apps
Single-screen UI-only templates without API or local state
Copy-pasted calculator / weather apps
market_demand.entry_level_reality: Hiring is steady across Indian consumer-tech and fintech startups, though overall posting volume is smaller than backend/full-stack. Candidates who publish a real app with offline storage, tests, and clean state management stand out immediately.
market_demand.source: Wellfound, Instahyre, Naukri.com & Stack Overflow Developer Survey

fresher_salary_range_inr.notes: Indicative 0-2 yr India range: semiconductor, automotive R&D, and storage/database GCCs in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune offer strong compensation for deep C/C++/Rust and OS skills.

hot_skills: Embedded C, FreeRTOS & Linux Kernel Modules
saturated_skills: Turbo C / outdated pre-C++11 console snippets
Arduino copy-paste blink sketches without datasheet literacy
Theory-only OS memorization with zero systems coding
market_demand.entry_level_reality: Smaller overall posting count than web, but far lower applicant noise because few freshers build genuine C/C++/Rust systems or RTOS firmware projects. Very resilient hiring in automotive, telecom, and semiconductor GCCs in India.
market_demand.source: LinkedIn Jobs India (0-2 yrs), GitHub Octoverse, Quess IT Staffing & Levels.fyi
